aiVerification.summary: The draft identifies a comparable coil-change report but misgroups the factor and contains unsupported extracted measurements.
issues: Changed factor is too generic and misclassified as equipment.
Baseline/test labels should be Normal vs Test New coil, not Test only.
Review title is a graph header, not the report title.
Many measurement outcomes are header-derived or nonsensical.
Visual/function citations and column parsing need validation.
correctionPlan: Set title from the Test sheet report title.
Define factor as coil stretching/shape change from normal to new square coil.
Rebuild visual and function tables with both Normal and Test rows.
Keep acoustic SPL, Fo, and THD as one valid outcome group using GRAPH/RAW averages.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations are partially sufficient for factor evidence but not for final outcomes.
